caseName: Burnet v. Howes Bros. Hide Co.
caseNameFull: Burnet, Commissioner of Internal Revenue v. Howes Brothers Hide Co.
attorneys: Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Youngquist, and Messrs. Claude R. Branch, Sewall Key, John Henry McEvers, and Paul D. Miller for petitioner., Mr. Robert A. Littleton for respondents.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The petition for a writ of certiorari in this case is granted. The decree *584herein is reversed upon the authority of Handy & Harman v. Burnet, ante, p. 136.

Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Youngquist, and Messrs. Claude R. Branch, Sewall Key, John Henry McEvers, and Paul D. Miller for petitioner. Mr. Robert A. Littleton for respondents.
